$comment: The Gaming preset from docs/03-features-core.md. Steps run in this order.
Every id here must exist in the matching whitelist file, or the profile fails to load.
Startup apps are deliberately absent - see docs/DECISIONS.md decision 17.
windows-update-cache is deliberately absent - see decision 23. Microsoft's own reset
procedure stops wuauserv and BITS before touching that folder, and a staged update awaiting
restart may be deletable but still needed. The group stays available for explicit ticking.
descriptionEn: Maximum speed. Fewer background effects, a faster power plan, gaming features on.
descriptionAr: أقصى سرعة. مؤثرات أقل، خطة طاقة أسرع، وخصائص الألعاب مفعّلة.
